catalysts.headline: Delaware bankruptcy court approved BioXcel's asset sale to Teva (reported deal value up to ~$125M total); judge also allowed the combined Chapter 11 plan and disclosure statement to go to a creditor vote
catalysts.impact: Resolves the previously-unresolved auction: no qualified competing bids emerged, so Teva (the stalking-horse bidder) was designated the successful bidder by default rather than via a live auction; sale closing was reportedly targeted for ~2026-10-26, which could not be confirmed as having occurred as of this session (today is 2026-10-22)
catalysts.source: Law360 (Emily Lever, Oct 21 2026, 'BioXcel Gets Nod For $125M Bankruptcy Sale To Teva'); corroborated by weekly bankruptcy-docket trackers (Bondoro, bankruptcyobserver.com)

catalysts.headline: Per the bidding-procedures motion, competing bids for BioXcel's assets were due Oct 9, 2026, with an auction proposed for Oct 14, 2026, ahead of an Oct 30, 2026 outside date for the sale; auction outcome (whether Teva's stalking-horse bid prevailed) could not be confirmed

BioXcel Therapeutics files for Chapter 11 and signs an asset purchase agreement with Teva as stalking-horse bidder for IGALMI (dexmedetomidine sublingual film, BXCL501) — $57.5M cash upfront, up to $67.5M in development milestones tied to the pending sNDA, up to $20M in commercial milestones, plus assumed liabilities
catalysts.impact: Major restructuring event; sale covers IGALMI/BXCL501 assets, not the whole company

catalysts.headline: Common stock trading suspended on Nasdaq at market open; migrated to OTC Pink Limited Market under new ticker BTAIQ; company said it does not intend to appeal

BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Delaware (Case No. 26-11360); Teva Pharmaceuticals named stalking-horse bidder for IGALMI/dexmedetomidine assets ($57.5M upfront + up to $67.5M milestones); Oaktree Capital and Qatar Investment Authority providing $19M new-money DIP financing (total DIP facility $77M)
BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions; entered an asset sale agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals as stalking-horse bidder in a court-supervised sale process
catalysts.impact: stock collapsed from ~$0.72 to ~$0.18 over the following sessions

catalysts.headline: FDA accepted BioXcel's sNDA to expand IGALMI label to at-home/outpatient use (Phase 3 SERENITY At-Home trial); PDUFA target action date Nov 14, 2026

conflicts: AUCTION OUTCOME: the on-file catalyst described competing bids due Oct 9 and an auction proposed for Oct 14 as unresolved. This session establishes that the Oct 14 auction was CANCELED on Oct 13, 2026 because no competing qualified bids were received; Teva (the original stalking-horse bidder) was named successful bidder by default, and the bankruptcy court approved the sale to Teva on Oct 21, 2026 (deal value reported as up to ~$125M). Whether the deal has actually closed (targeted ~Oct 26, 2026) could not be confirmed in this session.

Market cap / share count: current (Oct 2026) figures show the stock essentially wiped out (~$1.3M market cap on OTC Pink, suffixed .Q typically denoting bankruptcy), while several aggregator pages (Simply Wall St ~$29.8M at 27.07M shares in April 2026; Equibles ~$40.45M at 30.9M shares, undated; Google Finance ~$27.25M at 30.88M shares) show much higher, apparently pre- or early-bankruptcy-filing values. These cannot be reconciled without a dated, current quote, which this sandbox could not obtain (WebFetch to Nasdaq/OTC quote pages was policy-blocked, and the WebSearch budget ran out before a current-price search could be completed).

notes: Theme 'Distressed / Restructuring' fits well and is now strongly confirmed by the September 2026 Chapter 11 filing and subsequent court proceedings. This is the most important update in this batch: the previously-unresolved BTAI auction has been resolved — the live auction never happened (no competing bids), Teva was named successful bidder, and the bankruptcy court approved the ~$125M sale on 2026-10-21 (the day before 'today'). Equity holders should be aware the common stock appears to have collapsed to near-zero value consistent with a typical Chapter 11 equity wipeout, though this could not be fully confirmed with a current, dated quote in this sandbox. Cash, debt, EPS and shares-outstanding/float for the current period could not be established — WebFetch to SEC EDGAR and most financial news sites returned 403 policy-denial errors throughout this session, and the WebSearch budget was exhausted before these specific gaps could be filled via additional queries.
